discourse.title: Develop Social Consciousness
discourse.excerpt: Students should develop a spirit of sacrifice so that they are prepared to dedicate all their energies and talents to the service of others. For this purpose, they must cherish those moral values which will enable them to lead ideal lives. Wherever you may work and whomsoever you may meet, you should earn a good name.
discourse.theme: Education is preparation for serving society — dedicate your talents to others.

reflection: Swami says your education was never meant to end in a comfortable job — it was preparation for serving society. Whatever you have learned, whatever you earn, ask: whom does this serve? The spirit of sacrifice is what makes a life ideal. Pick one skill you have and offer it freely this week — one hour, one person. That is social consciousness, and that is worship. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 24, 22 Jul 1991)
seva_nudge: Offer one hour of your own skill — tutoring, a ride, a repair — to someone in your community this week.
